pr.body:
Adds the missing reconstructed keeper dwelling, a continuous high palisade front and a low braced compound gate beside the retained jail core. This is a bounded increment toward T-2380; the original picture match remains open.

## Image gate

Structures: `log_jail`, `log_jail_keeper_house`.

Both compound reference records remain **UNREVIEWED/DIFFERS**. A genuine current Gale1902 compound capture shows the added keeper body/openings but still differs in camera orientation and long-core/roof composition. The optional Andreas context capture stopped cleanly because its external fixture could not resolve a photo path; it is preserved as failed, with no retry or acceptance claim. The keeper gable triangle still uses the generic roof-shingle material. No full historic camera, metric, paint or whole-compound match is claimed.

## Validation and integration

- The retained genuine native keeper pair is preserved (MASTER `431dc44f`, WEB `15eb2fba`). Actual owner audits independently resolve all272 dwelling input recipes and verify544 native outputs, plus243 outbuilding pairs. This reuses the existing native build; it does not claim a new Blender execution.
- Current dev is integrated through ordinary merge commits. Fresh liberties, scene, source-use, derivative and validation owners pass. Concurrent parade, Cobweb, cupola, Lake House, Sauganash and Green Tree work is preserved and audited in its own scope; no foreign output is replaced with an older prepared asset.
- Actual published Jail body checks on tested commit3f3e0bf pass at desktop and phone (396.35s/222.00s), with exact native GPU picks and a short on-foot exterior approach. Desktop cards pass535.62s. Phone capture350.51s passes strict data/URL/rights/error checks and has separate direct image/SHA visual acceptance; this is not an automated visibility PASS.
- Both actual published native Stage3 runs pass107/0 (phone166.28s, desktop342.59s). Full15 smoke was **not run**. Tested3f's eight-part hosted gate passed. Later dev merges carry these runtime results only under explicit unchanged Jail consumer/asset and independently qualified shared-renderer audits; they are not presented as new executions on the later head. The current pushed head must pass its own required eight-part gate before merge.

Body review is limited to visible keeper presence/openings and exterior approach. Foreground stockade/fences occlude parts of the core; the desktop click-look prompt covers some wall/window area; no interior or doorway traversal is established. Phone's last core image credit is near the crop edge, and Record own-account controls are collapsed. The old164s/200s/137s helper-fixture failures remain preserved separately, never silently relabelled as passes.

Actual image bytes, proper process closure and recovery checkpoints:

- [Six executions, phone captures and preserved optional-render failure](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/blob/9f8a5cc3a57ccf1c7c0171ef2ece42306a4cb66a/evidence/log-jail-2026-11-04/pr1683-six-actual-executions-phonecapture-pending/RECOVERY.md)
- [Final cross-version ledger and bounded direct visual acceptance](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/blob/96e2af26c20b4b8acf7d81e535e7a3dd3be5cfdd/evidence/log-jail-2026-11-04/pr1683-six-leg-bounded-visual-acceptance/RECOVERY.md)
- [Current-dev source and native consumer audits](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/blob/7e17dd0da3857e2854cbf389f18fa8202fcc197e/evidence/log-jail-2026-11-04/pr1683-current-dev-b797-source-checkpoint/RECOVERY.md)

Original T-2380 remains partial/open. No photo follow-up or ticket completion is filed by this increment.
